plan.scope: Six serial fresh-context Linux WebKit windows: worker/control, control/worker, worker/control. diagnostics.application: Existing opt-in bounded performance session, exported after window when paused. Successful windows open ordinary public Menu to force Pause without the Pause-button toggle race; auto-paused windows receive no action. No serialization or per-frame object logging during play. diagnostics.defaultSmoke: Existing ordinary mode and eight-row plan unchanged. New opt-in flags affect only separate diagnostic windows.
diagnostics.attribution: A coincident worker event is not causal proof. Compare all three idle controls; retain actual app frame work, long intervals, phase transitions, startup and missing evidence separately.
diagnostics.limits: Linux WebKit26.5 pinned by Playwright1.62.1 does not qualify Safari/iOS or thermal conditions. No physical guarantee.
